units.source_text: 这次休假，他采取了极其保密的态度，对同事，他故意没告诉任何人自己的行踪。

en.t: For this vacation, he adopted an extremely secretive attitude, and deliberately told none of his colleagues where he was going.

units.source_text: 不仅没作声，他还有意让别人感到莫名其妙。

en.t: Not only did he keep silent, he also intentionally left others feeling baffled.

units.source_text: 他就是想让那些在日常灰色生活中连皮肤都发灰的家伙们发发急，这是再好不过的有效手段了。

en.t: What he wanted was to make those fellows, whose very skin had turned gray in the grayness of everyday life, grow anxious; there could be no better or more effective means.

units.source_text: 光是想象灰色种族中自己以外的人，具有了红的、蓝的、绿的等灰色以外的颜色，就会陷入无地自容的自我厌恶中去。

en.t: Merely imagining that someone other than himself among the gray race possessed colors besides gray, such as red, blue, or green, would plunge him into a self-loathing so intense that he had nowhere to hide.
